title: astragalus siculus subsp. calabricus
intro: Astragalus siculus subsp. calabricus, commonly known as the Calabrian milk-vetch, is a plant species within the legume family Fabaceae. This perennial herb is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus siculus subsp. calabricus are attributed to its ability to stimulate immune response, reduce oxidative stress, and modulate the activity of various enzymes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
